_about: Text changes the web build makes to its COPY of the shell; the source is never edited. Each 'find' must occur exactly once in its file, or the build stops, so a shell change that affects the web wording is caught. {keys} becomes the game's keysHelp from its web.json. A game's own changes go in its web.json. config: the web page's privacy policy, and no coin packs (no Google Play to sell them through).

replace.why: On the web, CrazyGames serves the ads, and Ad breaks only follow level-ups
replace.replace:
const SETTINGS_NOTE_ADS = 'Free, with ads by CrazyGames. Optional ads give rewards; past level 10, '
  + 'an Ad break may follow a level. {buy} {keys}';

replace.find: const SETTINGS_NOTE_NO_ADS = 'No ads. {buy} Progress saved on this phone.';
replace.replace: const SETTINGS_NOTE_NO_ADS = 'No ads. {buy} Progress saved in this browser. {keys}';
